main_text.p: ἀξία.neque dubium est Ciceronem duabus dictionibus fuisse vsurum, si potuisset, hoc est, si tulisset Latini sermonis paupertas.Modestiam hanc, siue ἀξίαν definiri ait ille à Stoicis, vt sit, scientia earum rerum quae aguntur aut dicuntur suo loco collocandarum.. recte sane & eleganter. Andronicus noster, sic: Εὐταξία, ἐμταξία καταχωρισμὸς πράξεως. ἢ, ἐχωρὶς τῆς καταχωρισμὸς πράξεων[?]. Non potuit rotundius vis Graecorum verborum exprimi, quàm vt fecit Cicero. Adiicit Andronicus & aliam definitionem, ἡ περὶ τὰς πράξεις ἐχωρὶς τὸ βέλτιον[?]. alludit horsum Tullius, Talis est igitur (ait) ordo actionum adhibendus, vt quemadmodum in oratione constanti, sic in vita omnia sint apta inter se & convenientia. Τὸ ἀκαιρίαν idem auctor infscientiam temporum eleganti[ssi]mè vertit. Importunitatem vero caue dixeris. In schida manu exarata reperi hanc ἀκαιρίας definitionem: Ἀκαιρία δὲ λείψις καιρῷ κατ' ἐπιθυμίαν προθυμία[?], τὸ ζηλούμενον.
ἐσὶν ἐπιτάξις.) ] Nihil mutandum. Attici ἐπιλυχάνειν pro ἐπιλυχάνειν vsurpant. vt Plato sexto Legum. ergo etiam ἐπιτάξις pro ἐπιτάξις.

καὶ δίκλω ὠφελητικὸς εἰγύνς.] Hoc veteres Latini dixissent, Eum qui sponsionem exactus fuerit. Plautus, Quas sponsiones pronuper tu exactus es. Cicero: qui quod pro alio spopondisset, coactus fuerit dependere. At κελεύειν αὐτὸν ἀναδέχεσθαι est sponsum vocare. Horatius, Hic sponsum vocat, hic auditum scripta. Notum quid sit ἀναδέχεσθαι. inde ἀνάδοχος. Glossarium Pras, ἐγγυος ἀνάδοχος. alibi, Vades, ἐγγυοι, ἀνάδοχοι.
ἔστιν ὁ καὶ προσοιὴν ἐν ὠνητῷ[?].) Mos fuit Athenis, vt qui vellent aliquid vendere certorum homi-num

page.notes: The Greek is only partly legible at this scan resolution; doubtful Greek words are marked [?] and may contain errors in accents and letters. The Greek line at the foot of the paragraph before "Mos fuit Athenis" is very faint, so its reading is a best guess. The first line starts mid-word ("ἀξία.neque") and is treated as a continuation from the previous page. The word "num" at the foot is the end of the split word "homi-num" and is kept in the paragraph. Some lines in the middle may be marginal glosses set in the column, but they are transcribed as running text because they stand inside the text block.
